hierarchy_composition.evidence: desktop_fold squint: one focal point -- white Archivo h1 on the yard-drums pagehead. Eye then splits to twin navy h2s (Your requirement | Contact details) at the same clamp size (~38px vs h1 44px). desktop_full: .wrap.cols.flip 6fr/5fr still reads 50/50; the form ends at Send quote request while two maps hold the row open, leaving a ~200px paper void before the footer reprints the same line at display size. Section order (quote banner -> form + named plant/office -> phones) is right. Prev: inner .cols 50/50 not fixed; inner h1 mad-lib not fixed (pagehead and footer h2 both Quote LABSA 90% from Gundlav). catalogue h2s, index h2#uses hanging the, about table clip: not visible. .btn:hover #000 waived (hover_submit.png).
strengths: Fold is one photo-backed claim, not a centred stack
Header Request a quote stays ghost; WhatsApp in the footer is outline
Footer skyline (tanks, tanker, drums) closes the page with a plant-shaped edge

issues.problem: Leftover 50/50 not fixed: form and Contact details are equal-weight columns, so the page's job (the form) does not win; maps stretch the row and dump empty paper under Send quote request.
issues.fix: Do not use .cols on this section. Stack: form full width, then a full-width maps band. If two columns stay, set grid-template-columns: 1.8fr 1fr, keep only phones/PDF in the rail, and move both iframes below the grid.

issues.problem: Inner h1 mad-lib not fixed. Squint shows two climaxes of the same sentence Quote LABSA 90% from Gundlav -- pagehead and footer -- so size is flattened and colour does all the hierarchy.
issues.fix: Keep the pagehead as the claim. Change footer h2 to the plant numbers only (already in .phones) or Call Gundlav -- +91 97277 02597. Drop the duplicate Request a quote button on contact.html; leave WhatsApp as the footer action.

reference_fidelity.evidence: No compare.png; scored vs DESIGN.md tokens. Navy/paper holds (--deep headings, --blue links, footer void + original tanks/tanker/drums skyline, not Vico green). Inner pagehead is translucent navy over yard photo as demanded. Square radius-0 matte CTAs; no header phone; disclaimer text only (disclaimer.png); maps in-page (factory_map.png, office_map.png -- Google Open in Maps chip is iframe chrome). Body still snaps to a generic manufacturer form|address split (prev major, not fixed). Header glass is rgba(255,255,255,.78) blur 16px vs token .86 / 14px. Inputs use --r 4px against square buttons.
strengths: Translucent navy pagehead and original plant skyline match the fidelity checklist
Contact demands executed: inline maps, no checkbox, no header phone, square matte buttons
Archivo + IBM Plex and scale 12.5/16/18/24/38.4/44 match the token table

issues.problem: Content beyond the pagehead still reads as a stock 50/50 manufacturer contact template instead of the 5/6 industrial devices in DESIGN.md.
issues.fix: Drop .cols on contact. Full-width form, then a place-map band (3px --blue left rule like .place) for Plot 79/80 and Silvassa, not a matching-height address column.

issues.problem: Fields use border-radius: var(--r) (4px) while every button is radius 0, so the control language splits between photo radius and square matte.
issues.fix: Set input, textarea, .place-map { border-radius: 0 } so form controls match the square matte buttons.
